envelope.description: Persist monotonic recovery state and preserve checkpoint errors

body.title: Persist monotonic recovery state and preserve checkpoint errors
body.summary: Extend existing atomic checkpoint save/load validation for per-unit counters, action replay identity, sealed completed-unit summaries, one-fill user-directed outcomes and fully frozen prior attempts. Normalize I/O failures at save boundary; preserve concrete domain error codes through coordinator commit and fence every failed save.
acceptanceChecks: Atomic failed writes preserve the previous accepted snapshot and block subsequent launch/advance.
Accepted baseline/plan/chunks and older attempts are immutable; per-unit counters/actions never decrease or disappear, completed summaries seal and action outcomes fill once.
Direct save and coordinator commit preserve domain codes such as checkpoint_too_large/foreign_checkpoint/immutable_history and normalize I/O failures to DesignReviewPersistenceError.

tests.name: Atomic checkpoint failures preserve accepted snapshots and fence execution; direct save and commit preserve domain versus normalized I/O errors.
Per-unit counters, action replay identity, one-fill outcomes, sealed summaries and prior attempts enforce monotonic immutable history.
